name: Article 7 – 50
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Temporary Decarbonisation Fund
part_text: 3b. Operators and downstream operators shall receive financial support from the Fund provided that they demonstrate to the satisfaction of the Commission that: (a) they have a legal commitment to use or source, where available, half of their equipment, supplies and materials, or their components, from the Union’s territory, for investments supported by the Fund; (b) they do not to use the financial support of the Fund for dividend payouts, in excess of expected returns, share buybacks or executive bonuses over the period of 2026-2027.
